title: A Primer of the Plain Stave
summary: Teaches an untrained body to hold, plant and swing a long plain stave without any qi.

title: Grip and Footing with the Long Pole
summary: Drills the sliding grip and the footwork that let a beginner change reach with a long wooden pole.

title: The Drill-Book of the Ash Quarter
summary: Sets out daily repetition drills that harden the arms and shoulders for striking with a staff of ash.

title: Walking Guard and Honest Strike
summary: Teaches a staff-bearer to move forward under cover of the stave and to answer attacks with simple strikes.

title: Workbook for the Village Stave
summary: A drill workbook for rural fighters teaching hardy staff work for defending a farm, road or village.

title: Treatise on the Hickory Shaft
summary: Describes how the weight and spring of a hickory shaft carry a swing and what grips suit it.

title: The Quarter Canon
summary: A first formal course, the canon of the staff, that adds light qi to strikes, guards and grips.

title: Circling the Stave: A Handbook
summary: A handbook of wheeling and circling work that shows how to keep the stave turning between strikes.

title: Staff-Bearer's First Lessons
summary: First lessons for a young staff-bearer who has awakened qi, covering simple guards, strikes and stepping.

title: The Short End and the Long End
summary: Treats the stave's two ends as separate tools and teaches switching reach with qi-timed strikes.

title: A Road-Guard's Stave Primer
summary: A primer for guards who walk long roads, teaching economical strikes and stout guards with a plain stave.

title: Breath and Shaft: A Beginner's Treatise
summary: Joins breathing to every stave motion so beginners learn to time qi to guard and strike.
